correct_completion: the researchers began writing the final report.
full_sentence: Having finished the experiment, the researchers began writing the final report.
acceptable_variants: the team started preparing the conclusions.
the scientists moved on to analysing the results.

options.text: the researchers began writing the final report.
the laboratory was closed for the weekend.
options.why_wrong: This describes an unrelated event and does not follow logically from completing an experiment.

options.text: the experiment will be finished tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the stem, which says the experiment has already been finished.

options.text: the equipment was being cleaned again.
options.why_wrong: Cleaning equipment does not logically continue from the idea of an experiment being completed.

grammar_focus: Participle clauses with perfect forms (having + past participle)
explanation: The perfect participle clause shows an action completed before the main action. The main clause must describe the logical next step.
translation: Deneyi bitirdikten sonra, araştırmacılar nihai raporu yazmaya başladı.
